scrubs.note: sensor tilt about the x axis; despace = L1-L2 air gap error; 'af' = autofocus re-optimised, 'fixed' = focus held at nominal

spec.rule: centre >= 90% of nominal AND every corner >= 80% of the nominal worst corner; (T+S)/2 MTF at Nyquist/4 = 111.6 lp/mm, 1.12 um pixel

B_quadratic_calibrated.note: Baseline B plus its own validation residuals (needs 1,000 traced modules)

surrogates.chosen_by: lowest validation corner RMSE (held-out set never used for selection)
surrogates.yield_estimator: threshold the prediction plus validation residuals (residual bootstrap, 40 draws); uncalibrated also reported

drivers.method: yield recovered if the group were perfect (others at current tolerance), surrogate on 60000 sampled modules; share = recovered / sum of recovered

intervals.method: paired bootstrap over held-out failing modules, 4,000 resamples, 95%

diagnosis.method: classifier: MLP on the 36 through-field MTF changes (9 fields x 2 freqs x T/S), trained on the 8 symmetry images of every training module; lookup: least-squares fit to a traced signature library (each culprit at 3x its limit, 8 directions for x/y pairs), best residual wins

reallocation.cost_model: cost proxy = sum over the 41 tolerances of (current limit / new limit); loosening a tolerance 2x halves its term

verification.note: fresh, independent ray-traced Monte Carlo (seed 3) on the reallocated budget vs the held-out modules of the current budget

paired.note: common random numbers: the 2,000 held-out draws of the main run (never used to train or select) re-traced with the reallocated limits; paired difference vs their current-budget traces

surrogate_intervals.reading: For the population yield alone, counting the 3,000 traced training modules is as good as the surrogate (both within sampling noise of the held-out truth). The surrogate's measured win is per module: worst-corner error and pass/fail calls on modules it never saw, which is what lets it score untraced budgets (drivers, reallocation).
surrogate_intervals.method: paired bootstrap over the 2,000 held-out modules, 4,000 resamples, 95%
